objective: Establish deterministic reference restore drills that validate backup integrity, quarantine, reconciliation requirements and reference RPO/RTO against the canonical P22-E backup targets without performing any real production restore or claiming production recovery performance.
scope: Bind restore drills to canonical P22-E BackupManifest inputs
Support deterministic RESTORE drills for DR0/DR1/DR2
Support deterministic REBUILD drills for DR3
Validate restored or rebuilt content integrity against the canonical source hash
Require restore quarantine when the P22-E class requires it
Require successful reconciliation for DR0 before a drill can pass
Measure reference RPO and reference RTO from explicit drill timestamps
Compare reference measurements with P22-E provisional architecture targets
Fail closed on ineligible backup manifests, invalid timing, integrity mismatch or unmet validation requirements
tests: DR0/DR1/DR2 restore drills validate integrity and explicit timing deterministically
DR3 uses REBUILD drill semantics and never claims backup restore
Invalid or blocked backup manifests fail closed
Reference RPO/RTO target comparisons are deterministic
Reference drill measurements are not labeled production-certified
P22-F evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P22-F restore-drill policy/module/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P22-A..P22-E remain canonical complete and P22-G remains unstarted.
definition_of_done: Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
